# Market Making

The business of Optiver, IMC, Citadel Securities, Jane Street, SIG, Akuna, DRW, Radix, HRT and Jump: quoting, inventory, hedging and the systems behind them.

The [Quant Dev Market Making Guide](Quant-Dev-MM-Guide/README.md) is the systems and protocol companion to these topics.
